title: lepismium incachacanum

This plant is primarily used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. Bioactive constituents of Lepismium incachacanum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
